```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Load libraries 
library(here)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
# Load data

huston_files <- list.files(path = "extreme-weather-impact-analysis/data/VNP46A1",
                        pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

feb7a <- read_stars(huston_files[1])
feb7b <- read_stars(huston_files[2])
feb16a <- read_stars(huston_files[3])
feb16b <- read_stars(huston_files[4])

roads <- read_sf(here("extreme-weather-impact-analysis", "data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg")) 

houses <- read_sf(here("extreme-weather-impact-analysis", "data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"))

# texas <- st_read(here("extreme-weather-impact-analysis", "data", "ACS_2019_5YR_TRACT_48_TEXAS.gdb/"))
```


```{r}
# Merge rasters for each date

feb7 <- st_mosaic(feb7a, feb7b)
feb16 <- st_mosaic(feb16a, feb16b)

```


```{r}
difference <- feb7 - feb16
plot(difference)
```

```{r}
blackout_mask <- difference > 200
plot(blackout_mask)
```

```{r}
blackout_mask[!blackout_mask] <- NA
plot(blackout_mask)
```

```{r}
vectorized_blackout <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask) |> st_make_valid()
```



```{r}
huston_coords <- cbind(
    x = c(-96.5, -96.5, -94.5, -94.5),
    y = c(29, 30.5, 30.5, 29)
)
```


```{r}
bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, xmax = -94.5, ymin = 29, ymax = 30.5), crs = st_crs(4326))
huston <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(bbox))
```


```{r}
blackout_cropped <- st_crop(vectorized_blackout, huston)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(blackout_cropped) +
    tm_borders()
```

```{r}
st_transform(blackout_cropped, crs = st_crs(3083))
```
